title: IntelliBlue: AI-Powered SOC Platform
description: Designed and built a fully local AI-powered Security Operations Center platform to assist with threat analysis, log monitoring, and alert triage. Implemented local language models to maintain 100% data privacy while automating MITRE ATT&CK mapping and incident response reporting.

title: Critical Security Vulnerabilities Discovery
description: Discovered and responsibly reported a critical Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) vulnerability in Al Ain University's online system, which exposed sensitive student data. Identified a second vulnerability that was patched before disclosure.

title: Cybersecurity Curriculum Modernization at Al Ain University
description: Advocated for and collaborated with university faculty to modernize the cybersecurity curriculum, shifting focus from theoretical learning to hands-on application. Integrated platforms like TryHackMe and Hack The Box into the coursework.

title: Enterprise Active Directory Home Lab
description: Designed and deployed three realistic enterprise Active Directory labs simulating corporate network environments. Practiced advanced AD exploitation techniques and internal network pivoting using industry-standard tools.
